title: Sepsis / severe infection (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Treat suspected sepsis as a medical emergency: start treatment and resuscitation immediately.

source.guideline: Evans L, Rhodes A, Alhazzani W, et al. Surviving sepsis campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021. Intensive Care Med. 2021;47(11):1181-1247. doi:10.1007/s00134-021-06506-y (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Quickly assess whether infection or another cause is more likely behind the illness: take the history, examine the patient, and immediately treat any condition that can look like sepsis.

source.guideline: Evans L, Rhodes A, Alhazzani W, et al. Surviving sepsis campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021. Intensive Care Med. 2021;47(11):1181-1247. doi:10.1007/s00134-021-06506-y (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Medication: per flight surgeon / onboard medical checklist.

source.guideline: team rule (Spec 5): medication stays with the flight surgeon; protocols never name a drug or dose

steps.text: Keep re-checking the patient and keep looking for other causes of the illness.

source.guideline: Evans L, Rhodes A, Alhazzani W, et al. Surviving sepsis campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021. Intensive Care Med. 2021;47(11):1181-1247. doi:10.1007/s00134-021-06506-y (Earth reference, no space data)
